opencode-ahp `0.1.9` — AHP 1.0.0 host for opencode v2, published to npm.

**Install** ([README — Install](https://github.com/mattzink/opencode-ahp/blob/main/README.md#install)):

```bash
opencode plugin add opencode-ahp
```

or pin this build: `opencode plugin add opencode-ahp@0.1.9`

- [ce38042](https://github.com/mattzink/opencode-ahp/commit/ce38042e32ca5ee9b0a373d6740015863a912533) Remove useless dates (Matt Zinkevicius)
- [eb78ba7](https://github.com/mattzink/opencode-ahp/commit/eb78ba7d0cebcb6f037d195dfa487cc53c3035ab) Force-stop the AHP listener on teardown so a reload can rebind the port (Matt Zinkevicius)
- [8ca31da](https://github.com/mattzink/opencode-ahp/commit/8ca31da4a56d945c947973abf32aead278cde9ed) Session customization catalog + MCP enable toggle (Matt Zinkevicius)
- [61c55d8](https://github.com/mattzink/opencode-ahp/commit/61c55d8012f3021a0f97d8ecb1fc0b82f75fc922) Directory allow list and legacy session-channel support (Matt Zinkevicius)
- [5ca1c45](https://github.com/mattzink/opencode-ahp/commit/5ca1c4541ccd256fc82986f875f031df4c76f706) Working directory handling (Matt Zinkevicius)
- [827186f](https://github.com/mattzink/opencode-ahp/commit/827186f2b9fbc62183840370436a7dcf6000b3b4) README updates (Matt Zinkevicius)
